data.exact_reserve_text:
Change of estimate
During the period, the managing agent refined its methodology for estimating claims reserves, including revising the actuarial methodology behind determining the risk margin to determine the appropriate level of margin in reserves. These changes have been accounted for prospectively as a change in estimate. As a result of these changes the reserves were strengthened by $4.1m in the period (on a net of reinsurance basis).

prior_year_events.event_name: Change of estimate / reserve methodology change
prior_year_events.impact_description: Managing agent refined actuarial methodology and risk margin; reserves were strengthened by $4.1m on a net of reinsurance basis.
Reduction in previously accrued reinstatement premiums associated with Hurricane Ian (related to reinsurance premium movements).

named_events.loss_description: Reduction in previously accrued reinstatement premiums associated with Hurricane Ian and re-estimations of reinsurance premium payable on proportional reinsurance contracts.

data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2023 were 138.7 (USD millions). Analysis of the gross claims development triangle indicates a small net favourable prior-year development of approximately 3.9m (USD) in 2023 (a release of ~2.8% of opening reserves), though movements across individual accident years were mixed. The managing agent also implemented a change in reserving methodology during 2023 which they report strengthened reserves by $4.1m on a net of reinsurance basis. A relatively quiet weather-related natural catastrophe season contributed to improved claims experience, particularly on property exposures.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development derived from the gross claims development triangle (gross), summing movements for underwriting years up to 2021. Some development-cell alignments in the printed table are unusual (large movements in older years and decreases in some middle years) and a change in reserving methodology (net strengthening $4.1m) may distort direct comparisons. The regulatory segmental premium split in the report is given as percentages of earned premiums rather than explicit amounts; hence class amounts are not provided and percentages were used where available. Amounts are reported in the syndicate functional currency (USD).
